In my 20s, I was a huge fan of Chris Cornell due to his earlier work with great bands. However, I picked up his second solo album, "Carry On" (on which "You Know My Name" resides). What I heard was one of the most bizarre albums I've ever heard. While each song was good, the entire album had zero flow. For the most part each song was of a different style.

Don't get me wrong. Cornell with Audioslave, brilliant. Cornell with Soundgarden, brilliant. Cornell with Temple of the Dog, brilliant. But take him away from a band and I feel like he's lost. It's like Morello outside of RAtM. Ever heard Nightwatchman? shudder I dunno. Maybe someone here likes it but not me.
